description: Opening every valid dataset succeeds (CHECK-1), including datasets with unusual but valid layouts. Core examples: hand-reviewed; their expectations are authoritative.

cases.description: parts: [] is a committed, empty dataset: open succeeds (no part files to check).
The simplest valid dataset (one part, two row groups, uncompressed PLAIN pages) opens.

Parts listed out of file-name order, empty row groups, three codecs, sha256 members, an extension and a stray unlisted file under the root: none of these may cause a refusal (LAYOUT-1, LAYOUT-3, EXT-1, PART-5: no digest check on open).
Fractional, exponent, negative, huge and nested values inside extensions are ordinary JSON: MAN-6's integer rules apply only to the defined members, so open succeeds.
Value columns use LZ4_RAW and BROTLI (outside ENC-1). The dataset is valid: open succeeds, or answers unsupported_encoding; a refusal is wrong.
A range over the empty dataset returns no entries rather than failing.
